issues.issue: Did the claimant suffer the alleged assaults by persecutors due to Roma ethnicity, given omissions from his PIF?
issues.applicant_position: Assaults by skinheads due to Roma ethnicity occurred; omissions from the PIF narrative were explainable.
issues.result_text: Credibility rejected on all alleged assaults; persecution as alleged not established.

issues.issue: Has the claimant rebutted the presumption of Slovak state protection?
issues.applicant_position: Police refused complaints without medical reports; state protection is unavailable to Roma victims.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not show inadequate state protection on balance of probabilities or rebut the presumption.
